categories.structural: exact table/column relationship, closed enum, validated time, identifier, or schema value
categories.synthetic-text: deterministic non-production text preserving equality partitions
categories.reference-synthetic: deterministic non-production identifier shared by an explicit reference group
categories.secret-synthetic: disjoint inert credential sentinel preserving nullness
categories.secret-null: NULL only; source column must be entirely NULL
categories.json-leaves: every JSON leaf at /** is replaced by type-preserving deterministic data
categories.sensitive-number: run-randomized bounded-domain bijection preserving null/equality/cardinality and SQLite storage type
categories.blob-digest: deterministic digest bytes preserving byte length
categories.dependent-digest: deterministic SHA-256 replacement derived from sanitized ownership row
categories.preserved-accounting: source accounting retained because the external binary body is absent
categories.virtual-derived: never copied; rebuilt from sanitized base tables
categories.shadow-derived: never copied; rebuilt by SQLite FTS5
